title: dock
description: App dock: pinned and running apps, its style (default/floating/integrated into the bar), edge, size and auto-hide.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Dock style; integrated puts the apps inside the bar.

hoverRegionHeight.title: Hover region height
hoverRegionHeight.description: Size of the edge strip that reveals the hidden dock.

hoverToReveal.title: Hover to reveal
hoverToReveal.description: Reveal the hidden dock when the pointer touches its edge.

availableOnFullscreen.title: Available on fullscreen
availableOnFullscreen.description: Allow revealing the dock over fullscreen windows.

showRunningIndicators.title: Show Running Indicators
showRunningIndicators.description: Mark apps that have open windows.

indicator.title: Indicator style
indicator.description: How running apps are marked; it follows the edge the dock is on.

x-settings.label: prefs.dock.indicator
x-settings.keywords: dock indicator running dot line glow brush style

ignoredAppRegexes.title: Ignored app regexes
ignoredAppRegexes.description: App ids matching these regexes never appear in the dock.

screenList.title: Screen list
screenList.description: Monitor names to show the dock on; empty = every monitor.

keepHidden.title: Keep hidden
keepHidden.description: Keep the dock hidden until revealed.

magnification.title: Magnification
magnification.description: Magnify dock icons under the pointer (dock-style panels).

magnificationScale.title: Magnification scale
magnificationScale.description: Size of the icon under the pointer when magnifying.

launchBounce.title: Launch bounce
launchBounce.description: Bounce a dock icon while its app launches.
